in_sanskrit.name: कवय्य
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who composes or creates poetry

in_marathi.name: Kavayya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kavayya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from Sanskrit words 'kavi' (poet) and 'ayya' (scholar), Kavayya signifies a person who is skilled in poetry and knowledgeable in various subjects.
